Active as of 2026-09-03 Computable Name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Titer_Tests_LOINC

Tests-ValueSet für die Titerbestimmung: LOINC-Codes für semiquantitative Messungen aus Verdünnungsreihen.

References

  • MII PR Mikrobio Titer

Logical Definition (CLD)

  • Include codes fromhttp://loinc.org version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where PROPERTY = LP6881-9 (Titr), CLASS = LP7819-8 (MICRO) and STATUS = ACTIVE
